svg.title: Mock Named Entities dashboard
svg.desc: Mock Contact Intelligence dashboard, Named Entities page (demo, mock data). Sidebar with Named Entities selected. Filters: LOB-A, Jan 1 to Mar 31, entity type Procedures. Entity type list: Benefits, Specialists, Procedures (selected), Diseases. Bar chart of top procedure classes: Radiology imaging 18.4K calls, Laboratory studies 15.1K, Physician visit 13.7K, Cardiothoracic procedures 9.2K (highlighted), Physical therapy 8.6K, Maternity procedures 4.9K, ENT procedures and testing 3.8K, Infusion therapy 3.1K. Drill-down table for Cardiothoracic procedures, value as mentioned and calls: stress test 4.1K, echocardiogram 2.6K, cardiac catheterization 1.5K, EKG 1.0K.
svg.text: Entity classes mentioned in calls. Click a class to see the raw values behind it.
